{{Quote|Exquisite.''"<br />"''Quite. A gift from Senator Eelen Li.''"<br />"''From Triffis.|Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum and Palpatine, about a Triffian carving|<ref name="DP" />}}
'''Eelen Li''' was a [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]]<ref name="FF22" /> who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from<ref name="DP" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FF22" /> [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]]<ref name="DP" /> and worked as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FF22" /> She gifted a near-[[Time/Legends|prehistoric]] [[Stone/Legends|stone]] [[Unidentified Triffian carving|carving]] portraying a Triffian from a [[Unidentified Triffian museum|museum]]<ref name="FF22" /> on Triffis<ref name="DP" /> to Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], after learning about his love of antiques.<ref name="FF22" /> The carving was placed in his apartment in [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] on<ref name="FF22" /> the planet<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="FF22" /> by [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The twenty-second chapter of [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], during which the [[Unidentified Triffian carving|Triffian carving]] is located in [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|Palpatine's apartment]], is set during the [[Yinchorri Uprising|Yinchorri Uprising]]. The uprising also happens during the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which {{DarkHorse|url=Zones/StarWars/Timeline|text=Comics Timeline}} dates to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Palpatine hosted an informal gathering at the apartment with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and his [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taira]]. Valorum and Palpatine discussed the carving; the latter mentioned Li while they talked.<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eelen Li was first mentioned in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 32|thirty-first]] issue of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File|The Official Star Wars Fact File Magazine]]'', published on [[August 7]], [[2002]].<ref name="FFDate">{{FFdates|32}}</ref>
